Lessons: Who Is God?; Who Is Jesus?; Who Is the Holy Spirit?; What Is Sin and Why It Matters; Salvation by Grace Through Faith; Assurance and New Life in Christ; Growing in Faith Day by Day
Description: Whether you are brand new to faith or returning after a long time away, this gentle course lays the essentials down clearly and kindly. You will discover who God is, what Jesus has done, and how to begin a confident, everyday walk with Him.
